cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(rlImGui)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(RLIMGUI_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# rlImGui.cpp 内部同时实现了 imgui_impl_raylib 后端，编译它即可
add_library(rlImGui STATIC
    ${RLIMGUI_DIR}/rlImGui.cpp
    ${RLIMGUI_DIR}/rlImGui.h
)

# 公开 rlImGui 根目录（rlImGui.h / imgui_impl_raylib.h / rlImGuiColors.h）
target_include_directories(rlImGui PUBLIC ${RLIMGUI_DIR})

# 依赖 imgui 核心与 raylib；
# imgui_static / raylib_static 会以 PUBLIC 方式提供各自头文件目录
target_link_libraries(rlImGui PUBLIC imgui_static raylib_static)
